sources.description: First-hand real-time testimony from UnTelevised Media correspondent Salah Akram, on the ground near Khan Younis during escalated Israeli bombardment across Gaza, Khan Younis, Deir al-Balah, and Al-Mawasi. Kitchen strike near Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital kills 3. Civilian casualties in Khan Younis. Artillery, gunboats, and drone strikes across the Strip. All timestamps Central Time.
sources.label: Salah Akram — Eyewitness, Khan Younis (May 17, 2026)
